_meta.about: Music analysis + picks for "What If Real Life Had a SETTINGS MENU?". Times are seconds in the original file; load with lib.load_music(track_key, t0, t1) (same ffmpeg decode as the analysis).

methods.tempo: librosa 1.0 beat_track (22.05 kHz, hop 512) seeded with the Epidemic BPM tag; bpm = least-squares grid fit over all tracked beats (matches the tag within 0.02 BPM on 18/20 tracks; grid_resid_ms = rms beat deviation from the grid, ~1 analysis frame = 23 ms).
methods.downbeat: phase of the beat grid (meter 3 or 4) with the strongest low-band onset + chord change + onset accent; verified by hand on the picked cues (hits fall on grid downbeats).
methods.key: Krumhansl-Kessler template correlation on harmonic-part CQT chroma (whole track; per section in sections[].key).
methods.loudness: BS.1770 K-weighted, non-overlapping 0.5 s blocks (loudness_05s), integrated lufs_i in library.json.
methods.sections: Foote novelty on a beat-synchronous chroma+MFCC+RMS self-similarity matrix, peaks snapped to the nearest downbeat.
methods.hits: top 16 onset-strength peaks with a 100 ms loudness jump; edit_points are hand-checked with a 5-10 ms envelope (scripts/hits.py): a pair [onset, peak] = start of the attack and the loudest 10 ms (put the peak on the cut frame; the big trailer hits swell 50-75 ms).
methods.stops: loudness falls >=12 dB within 0.3 s and stays down >=0.3 s (natural breaks to cut on).
methods.loops: bar-aligned 4/8/16-bar windows whose continuation after t1 matches the bar at t0 (seam_sim, cosine of chroma+MFCC).
methods.character: rule-based guess from spectral centroid, HPSS percussive ratio, sub energy, pulse clarity, onset rate, stereo width, mode, tags.

_meta.target_ref: Reference cold open A minor-ish 122 BPM; Day 1 G major 120 BPM bouncy plucks; music under -48 LUFS for drops 0.3-2 s, 2.5/min (production_bible 1.5).

first.why: The only cue with a ready-made trailer arc in its first 20 s: an opening hit (0.80) for the title, three hits two beats apart (6.425 / 7.38 / 8.28, 23 / 12 / 16 dB rises) for "One app." / "Total control." / "No undo.", a hard cut to a sub drone at 15.60 for the flash-forward dread, a reversed riser 18.78-19.35 and a full-band slam at 19.395. D minor, 130 BPM (grid fit 130.01, tag 130), heavy sub, -9.7 LUFS integrated.
first.edit: Cut on the hits: [0.70-6.30] under L001 (hit at 0.80, tonal tail), [6.35-7.30] on "One app.", [7.30-8.20] on "Total control.", [8.20-15.55] on "No undo." (UNDO cracks: glass_crack + glass_break on the same frame); each hit masks the previous tail, so joins need only a 10 ms crossfade. Flash-forward L005-L007 over [15.60-19.30] (drone + riser), slam 19.395 on the Day 7 reveal or the 412 counter; hard music stop before "...Ish." (L008) then VHS rewind into (b).

alternates.why: C# minor 130-feel; entry hit 27.685 from near silence, then a hit every 2.775 s (30.465, 33.235, 36.005, 38.78 ...), lift 60.915. Regular spacing makes line-per-hit editing easy; less "title" punch at the very start (dark drone before 27.6).
Softer "Hopeful; Suspense" (E minor -> E major), hits 16.15, 45.69, 53.08, 60.485; use if Our Last Stand feels too heavy.

b_bedroom_213am.lines: S00-L009..L016 (rewind into the 2:13 a.m. bedroom, the app appears, T&C, I AGREE)

first.why: Twinkly, curious, a little spooky: sparse music-box/celesta-like plucks over soft sustained tones, C minor/major colours, "Sneaking; Dreamy", 65 BPM (130 feel), quiet -21..-17 LUFS (sits under narration without ducking much), almost no percussion (perc ratio 0.02). First note 0.315; a layer enters at 15.145 (good for the app appearing on "An app you never downloaded.").
first.edit: In 0.30 after the VHS rewind; let it run under L009-L015; cut it 0.1-0.2 s before "I AGREE" so the sub boom + ripple land in silence; the full-band entry at 44.57 is not used here (keep for the ending twist reprise).

alternates.why: Sneaky pizzicato, B minor 121 BPM, built-in stops every bar 3.0-8.6 s (comic tip-toe feel); more comedic, less magical.
Quiet "mysterious" middle (-20 LUFS) of a contemporary-classical cue, F# major; busier texture.

c_welcome_brightness.lines: S00-L017..L022 ("Welcome to Reality Settings!" + brightness gag), hard drop on S00-L023 "That's the planet's."

first.why: Brightest track in the library (median centroid 2450 Hz), E major with the strongest key fit (r=0.91), happy bit-music/electro: reads as the app's own theme. Built-in boot-up: boops on 8ths 0.195-1.995, then the full-groove downbeat at 2.392 -> put the toast "Welcome to Reality Settings!" on 2.392. 150 BPM (grid 149.995), loud (-9.1 LUFS: pull it ~6 dB under the bed target).
first.edit: In 0.10 on the I AGREE ripple tail; toast on 2.392; next section 15.02 can hit "Slide it up"; hard cut (<=20 ms fade) on "That's the planet's." and hold 0.5-0.8 s of silence (or a sub_boom/whoosh_long into the snap zoom), then (d).

alternates.why: Quirky orchestral comedy, E major 85 BPM, full entry 11.11 after a dip; acoustic rather than digital, same composer as (d).
A major (r=0.96) glamorous waltz; the +7.4 dB lift at 26.03 fits the moon-to-sun flare.

c_welcome_brightness.tradeoff: Using a chiptune here means Day 5 (graphics low) should take a different 8-bit cue (Alleyways of Seoul).

d_day1_slam.lines: S01-L001 "Day one." DAY 1 card slam -> Day 1 comedy bed

first.why: C major 120 BPM (grid 120.01, tag 120), "Funny; Quirky", bouncy plucks with sliding-bass glides (9-30 s): the closest match to the reference Day 1 bed (G major 120 BPM, bouncy plucks). Pickup hits 6.325/7.33 then the groove downbeat 8.87 (+6.9 dB).
first.edit: DAY 1 card slam on the 8.87 downbeat (whoosh_short peak + impact_hit/sub_boom on the same frame); optionally start at 6.30 so the two pickup hits play under the card fly-in. Sections 8.87-28.9 and 28.9-44.9 give 20 s each; 8-bar loop 46.86-62.86 (seam similarity 0.996).

alternates.why: G major 120 BPM bouncy staccato; its own slam at 8.495 after a silence (7.3-8.49) is a ready-made card slam; mini-stops at 22.7, 54.2, 68.7 for drops.
G major (r=0.91) silent-film comedy band, 105 BPM, constant high energy from 2.02.

3_days_1_2_comedy_bed.why: Two different 120-BPM major comedy beds (C major plucks + sliding bass; G major staccato with built-in stops). Buster (G major 105) and Tree House Story (E major 85) as extra textures; No Dessert (F major 88, quirky) for the breakfast scene.

4_day2_rules_day3_school.why: Playful sneaky staccato at 121 BPM with stops on every bar (rules being read out), B minor; College Dropout (G minor 123, eccentric) for school; the "march_band" SFX (35 s brass march) covers a literal march gag.

5_day3_2x_speed.why: Ragtime piano band, C major 153 BPM, funny = honky-tonk chase; play it 1.0x, the picture is 2x.

6_day4_pickles_posh_cat.why: Baroque gavotte with a bright harpsichord-like timbre (centroid 2150 Hz) = snooty/aristocratic; Versailles (A minor baroque ensemble) and Take Me to Prom (A major waltz, glamorous) as alternates.

7_day5_low_graphics.why: 8-bit chiptune, C major, 180 BPM (90 feel), constant level, 8-bar loop 0.372-11.029 (seam 0.997); bit-crush it further.

8_day6_chaos_day7_countdown.why: Unfettered builds in stages (drone -> hit every 2.775 s -> lift 60.9 -> final build 174-238.5, 2-s break, ending) for Day 6 -> Day 7; Our Last Stand returns for the Day 7 climax as a callback to the cold open (slams 126.58 and 157.82). Both minor.

9_ending_and_twist.why: Major-key "Hopeful" resolution: 45.3-106 lifts (E major), calm outro 119-136; the brass TA-DA is the SFX "fanfare" (cartoon_musical_success_fanfare); for the 2:13 a.m. twist reprise 12 O'Clock Magic 0.3-6 or the "tension_sting" SFX (orchestral swell, peak 2.8 s).

unused.why: A Christmas arrangement of a national anthem (solo piano/celesta, Eb major, peaceful/low) does not fit a comedy channel; nothing in the plan needs it.
